# iosxe_voice_class_sip_profiles (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class SIP Profiles configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_sip_profiles" "example" {
  tag         = 100
  description = "Header normalization"
  rules = [
    {
      rule                              = 10
      request_method                    = "ANY"
      request_sip_header                = "Contact"
      request_sip_header_modify_pattern = "@.*:"
      request_sip_header_modify_replace = "@cube.example.com:"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class sip profiles tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `description` (String) Description of a sip-profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Specify the rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
